snippet.title: Collect the dead or join them | Crow's Requiem 💀 Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
🚛 PLAY on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859230/Crows_Requiem 

Crow's Requiem is a  narrative #cRPG inspired by games like Disco Elysium and #TTRPG storytelling traditions. Become a Licensed Body Collector in a Pandemicpunk world 🚨 here, the final war never came, the bombs never dropped, monsters never emerged.

What came was the illness.
But it never left.

Enter the Long-Quarantined City of New Horizon: make choices, meet citizens, gather reputation, and collect your dead. 

🚨 Play & Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3859230/Crows_Requiem

Trailer Credits:

Editor: Rodrigo Doze
Soundtrack: William França
Vocal: Natasha Durski / @feralkat 
Narrator: Sid Osna
